releaseNotes: MEC POS Zenith Merchant v1.0.50: B2B Wholesale & Fleet Distribution Hub matching C# Desktop POS — 6 pipeline tabs (Pending Bookings as default, Warehouse Packing, Vehicle Handover, Delivered & Collected, Direct Van Sales, All Distribution), date range filter with quick chips for Delivered and Van Sales, streamlined 1-tap Store packing & vehicle handover workflow, instant order cancellation with automatic stock return.
